api_record_json: {"bisPlayerId": 772005, "pickRound": "4", "pickNumber": 120, "displayPickNumber": 120, "roundPickNumber": 15, "rank": 103, "pickValue": "441700", "signingBonus": "397500", "home": {}, "scoutingReport": "http://m.mlb.com/video/topic/210960834/v1214588583", "school": {"name": "Lipscomb"}, "blurb": "Gigliotti had a breakout summer in the Cape Cod League, where scouts voted him the circuit's top prospect and Jeff Trundy, his manager at Falmouth, said he was more advanced than Jacoby Ellsbury was when he played for the Commodores.
